acquisition_method.evidence: In this study we profiled the urinary EV proteome of 8 healthy individuals over 6 months at 9 timepoints (total 72 samples) using DIA-MS.
Eluting peptides were measured on-line by a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher, Bremen, Germany) operating in data-dependent acquisition mode.
